global_instructions: You are writing one section of a financial advice report addressed to the client. Write in clear British English, first person plural ('we'). Output only the prose for this section: no headings, no preamble, no tables. Use only the facts provided. Never invent figures, fee rates, or tax amounts.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.template:
Further to our recent discussions, we are writing to set out our advice in relation to <<scope>>. This advice is based on the information currently available to us.

This firm is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

sections.title: Background & Objectives
sections.template:
<<summary>>

The accounts covered by this report are as follows:

<<holdings_table>>

summary.prompt: In two or three sentences, summarise the client's objectives and circumstances at a HIGH LEVEL. Do NOT state any specific transaction amounts, top-up sizes, sale proceeds, or tax figures. If sensitive guidance is provided (e.g. an inheritance following a death), reflect it tactfully.

recommendation.prompt: Describe what the client should do and why, using only the recommended actions, account values, and other funds provided. State the amounts involved only where they are explicitly given. Do NOT compute or assert any new figure (do not add balances together or project future/post-transaction values). Do NOT state numeric fee rates or tax amounts.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.template:
The value of investments can fall as well as rise and you may get back less than you invest. Past performance is not a guide to future returns.

If you are happy to proceed with our recommendations, please let us know and we will implement them for you.
